mainScript.description: Main Legend Mod client script containing core game rendering, networking, settings and UI.

modules.description: Fuzzy-search palette (Ctrl+K) for all settings, hotkeys, theme options and windows. Multi-language search with accent normalisation.
Synchronises theme settings between game CSS variables and the settings panel. Handles --lm-radius, --lm-pc2, --lm-tc2, --lm-mc variables.
Accessibility features: reduced motion, text scale, HUD text scale, opponent indicators, focus warnings.
Statistics dashboard with heatmaps, play pattern analysis (coach), personal objectives, game summaries. Tracks position samples, splits, kills.
Second-screen companion broadcasting live game state via BroadcastChannel. Mass, rank, minimap, leaderboard, chat widgets.
Death recap showing last 20 seconds of life as 3-6 summarised steps with mass sparkline. 128-sample ring buffer, 64-event ring buffer.
Full gamepad/controller support with customizable button mapping (16 buttons), dead zone, response curve, haptic vibration.
Split range circles, merge countdown, relative mass, edge arrows, cell panel, mass format modes, virus range circles.
Drag and resize HUD elements with named layouts. Up to 20 saved layouts, grid snapping (8/16/32px).
Notification centre with bell icon, unread count, 8 categories, 4 types. Up to 200 notifications, 120KB storage limit.
Full replay playback with timeline, bookmarks, variable speed (0.25x-4x), backward seeking, packet-by-packet stepping.
Settings profiles management. Up to 30 named profiles, auto-switching per server/mode/input device, 5 automatic backups.
Offline practice mode against bots using MultiOgar protocol. Personal bests, ghost replay, deterministic physics (mulberry32 RNG).
Spectator Director: auto-camera following action, watchlist (20), map bookmarks (20), cinematic camera, broadcast HUD, leaderboard history.
Custom macro editor. 3 slots, up to 24 steps, dry run mode, safety limits (20ms split gap, 10ms feed gap).
User scripts/plugins system. 5 slots, LMPlugins API with settings registration, version compatibility checking.
Experimental features toggle. Modules register experiments with on/off switches stored separately from settings.
Feature guide cards introducing Legend Mod features. One-tap option switches, auto-opens after updates.
Collection of small utility tools: sound mixer, minimap features, leaderboard features, various UI helpers.
Performance diagnostics, adaptive performance (3 levels), frame time tracking, Chrome Long Animation Frames API, net graph.
Theme creation and management. Up to 30 themes with 5 versions each, live preview, gallery, export/import.
Hotkey command system with 146+ unique hotkey bindings. Toggle hotkeys, zoom levels, chat commands, bot controls.
Chrome extension bridge script. Handles extension-to-page communication, theme queries and hashing.
